overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving insufficiently detailed minutes for February 12 and 26, 2019 executive sessions; the minutes had been revised, so only future compliance was ordered, and no intentional violation was found.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board approved insufficiently detailed minutes for executive sessions held February 12 and 26, 2019.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving insufficiently detailed minutes of its February 12 and February 26, 2019, executive sessions.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the insufficiently detailed minutes were intentional, part of a pattern to conceal a member's involvement with the property.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to find an intentional violation in this instance.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (no further remedial action, since the Board had already revised the minutes).
remedy_passage: We order the Board immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
